references.text: The ark of the covenant was also to be overlaid with pure gold, both inside and out, with a gold rim around it—the same construction principle as the altar of incense.
The table for the showbread was to be overlaid with pure gold and have a gold rim around it, in the same way as the altar of incense.
The description of the construction of the altar of incense with horns at its corners, which was also to be overlaid with gold.
Fulfillment of the command—Bezalel made the altar of incense and overlaid it with pure gold, including its top, sides, horns, and the gold rim around it.
Solomon's temple had an altar of incense overlaid with gold, in keeping with the pattern from the tabernacle.
The book of Hebrews mentions the golden altar of incense as part of the furnishings of the sanctuary, pointing back to the equipment of the tabernacle.
Direct fulfillment: The verse describes the actual execution of the command given in the source verse.
